meta.name: writing-for-agents
meta.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 AI 助手撰写清晰可执行的协作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为 AI 助手制定明确的规则与工作流程
copy.tagline_en: Write clear, actionable guidelines for AI assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to define clear rules and workflows for AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在编写任何给 AI 读的文档(如技能说明、AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md、被引用的文档)时,会遵循信息层级组织内容、给步骤定完成标准、避免重复和废话、用简洁的关键词引导调用。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或编辑技能,或修改 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个技能,参考 writing-for-agents 的原则来写描述。
say.note: Claude 会按技能文档规范生成描述并给出触发词。

say.text: 更新我们的 AGENTS.md,把每个步骤都加上完成标准。
say.note: 它会按信息层级重排内容,避免重复。

say.text: 这份说明文档太长了,帮我拆成几个文件并写好转入的指针。
say.note: 它会做渐进式披露,减少不必要的上下文。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows information-hierarchy principles when writing agent-facing documents (skills, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, referenced docs): sets completion criteria for steps, avoids duplication and no-ops, and uses leading words to guide invocation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a skill, or to modify AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

say_en.text: Create a new skill and write its description following the writing-for-agents principles.
say_en.note: Claude will structure it with clear triggers.

say_en.text: Update our AGENTS.md and add completion criteria to every step.
say_en.note: It will reorganize by hierarchy and remove duplication.

say_en.text: Split this long doc into files and add pointers to them.
